extraction.notes: Read in full: pages 1-52 (page 1 is the scanned approval order, page 2 the title page, page 52 the abbreviations list). Romanian only: stated_text is the Romanian text as converted, translation_en is the extracting agent's translation, machine_translated is true and evidence confidence is capped at Medium. The document is mostly a landscape table (action, indicator, deadlines, unit, responsible person, status, comments); the converted text interleaves the columns, so quotes are taken from contiguous runs of the comments column and flagged table. Text pages equal PDF pages; the report has no printed page numbers. All items are theme TECH-CYBER (two also TECH-DATA for the state register of cyber incidents); no Chapter 2 content. The report links each objective to PNA Chapter 10 items 1-5 and Chapter 31 item 8; this is recorded in the objective items' notes, not as chapter tags, because the passages themselves are not under a chapter heading. Left out: the Agency's internal IT set-up (actions 1.2 to 1.4: networks, Active Directory and PKI, Microsoft 365), internal protection of state secrets and personal data (action 11), awareness posts on the website and social media, a single study visit and single training events, defence cooperation (PESCO), research and university cooperation (Objective VII, page 41), the internal register of agreements (page 27), general opinions on draft acts, and human resources, integrity and budget objectives IX and XI (pages 43-51) except one staffing metric. Doubtful for the analyst: item 0012 (the Agency's own data centre as incident-response capacity) and item 0065 (staffing metric) are flagged theme_doubtful. The status column says 'Realizat' for action 5.2 although the comment says the SIEM is still being configured (item 0018, recorded in_progress). Several statements (Cyber Reserve during the electoral period, pages 26-27; ECCC memorandum, pages 41-42) are split by the table layout and could not be quoted. Second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-GOV8f on 5 November 2026: 6 items added (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MDA-GOV-2026-010.csv).

items.stated_text: Planul de activitate al Agenției pentru Securitate Cibernetică a fost implementat, în mare parte, conform obiectivelor stabilite, cu progrese semnificative în consolidarea capacităților naționale de prevenire, monitorizare și răspuns la incidente cibernetice. În pofida faptului că Agenția se află într-o etapă relativ recentă de constituire, majoritatea acțiunilor planificate au fost realizate integral , iar unele parțial, fiind create premisele necesare pentru funcționarea durabilă a mecanismelor instituționale în domeniul securității cibernetice.
items.translation_en: The activity plan of the Cyber Security Agency was largely implemented in line with the objectives set, with significant progress in strengthening national capacities for preventing, monitoring and responding to cyber incidents. Although the Agency is at a relatively recent stage of establishment, most planned actions were fully implemented and some partially, creating the conditions needed for the sustainable functioning of institutional mechanisms in cybersecurity.
items.summary: The Agency's own assessment: its 2025 plan was largely implemented, most actions fully, despite the Agency being recently established.
items.extraction_note: Self-assessment by the issuing body in the unheaded summary on page 3.

pass2.classification_note: Finding on how the named action plan was applied. Self-assessment by the Cyber Security Agency.

items.stated_text: Pentru fortificarea Agenției,  a fost pus  accent pe operaționalizarea CSIRT -ului național, dezvoltarea infrastructurii IT, implementarea soluțiilor de monitorizare, detecție și răspuns  la incidente (inclusiv SIEM, MISP, ticketing și protecție DDoS), precum și pe gestionarea incidentelor și vulnerabilităților la nivel național.
items.translation_en: To strengthen the Agency, emphasis was placed on operationalising the national CSIRT, developing IT infrastructure, implementing monitoring, detection and incident response solutions (including SIEM, MISP, ticketing and DDoS protection), and managing incidents and vulnerabilities at national level.
items.summary: In 2025 the Agency focused on operationalising the national CSIRT and its monitoring, detection and incident response tools.
items.intervention_as_stated: Operaționalizarea CSIRT-ului național
items.extraction_note: Recorded as in_progress: the wording says emphasis was placed on operationalisation, not that it is complete. Detailed in the Objective I table (pages 6-20).

items.stated_text: la nivel normativ a fost aprobat Conceptul tehnic al registrului de stat al incidentelor cibernetice precum și a Regulamentului cu privire la modul de ținere a acestuia. Prin aceste acte normative a fost creat cadrul normativ privind dezvoltarea propriu-zisă a unui registru național.
items.translation_en: At the regulatory level, the technical Concept of the state register of cyber incidents was approved, as well as the Regulation on how it is kept. These acts created the regulatory framework for actually developing a national register.
items.summary: The concept and keeping rules for a state register of cyber incidents were approved, creating the framework for developing it.
items.intervention_as_stated: Conceptul tehnic al registrului de stat al incidentelor cibernetice și Regulamentul cu privire la modul de ținere a acestuia
items.extraction_note: Quote starts mid-sentence at the claim. Detailed at page 16 (Government Decision No. 822/2025), extracted there because the wording differs.

pass2.classification_note: Regulatory basis for an operational incident register.

items.stated_text: În paralel, Agenția a realizat progrese importante în identificarea, evidența și interacțiunea cu furnizorii de servicii esențiali și importanți, în conformitate cu Legea nr. 48/2023. Au fost transmise notificări, și emise acte administrative individuale de desemnare în calitate de furnizor de servicii , contribuind la stabilirea listei furnizorilor de servicii și la responsabilizarea acestora prin obligativitatea normativă de a respecta prevederile Legii 48/2023 și a actelor de punere în aplicare a acesteia.
items.translation_en: In parallel, the Agency made important progress in identifying, recording and interacting with essential and important service providers under Law No. 48/2023. Notifications were sent and individual administrative acts designating service providers were issued, helping to establish the list of service providers and making them accountable through the legal obligation to comply with Law 48/2023 and its implementing acts.
items.summary: The Agency identified essential and important service providers under Law 48/2023 and issued designation acts, building the list of providers.
items.intervention_as_stated: Identificarea și desemnarea furnizorilor de servicii esențiali și importanți conform Legii nr. 48/2023

pass2.classification_note: Applying the cybersecurity law to essential and important providers (NIS2-type obligations).
